subject: error trying to install seewave in iMac OS X Yosemite

messages.author: 0e928df446db93eb
messages.subject: error trying to install seewave in iMac OS X Yosemite
parts:
Dear group,

I am using R v3.2 in a iMac OS X Yosemite. I tried install seewave, it asked to install from source and after initiate fine gives an error message after attempt to test if the package can be loaded. Have some of you experienced this error? Could you please help me to figure out the problem?

Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'seewave', details:
  call: dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...)
  error: unable to load shared object '/Users/jtonini/Library/R/3.2/library/seewave/libs/seewave.so':
  dlopen(/Users/jtonini/Library/R/3.2/library/seewave/libs/seewave.so, 6): Library not loaded: /usr/local/lib/libFLAC.8.dylib
  Referenced from: /usr/local/opt/libsndfile/lib/libsndfile.1.dylib
  Reason: image not found
Error: loading failed
Execution halted

Best
João

--

messages.author: 0e928df446db93eb
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] error trying to install seewave in iMac OS X Yosemite
parts:
Dear Jerome

Thank you, I did not see the thread before. I have compiled xcode, fftw and libsndfile, however the same error persists. It looks like a problem with the path of dynamic library, so I put libFLAC.8.dylib in /usr/local/lib together with libsndfile.dylib and libsndfile.1.dylib libraries, and add /usr/local/lib to $DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, even though it is still not working. I am not an expert in programing and I have been struggling with this problem for a while. Please, would you have other suggestions how to solve this?

Best
João
